#!/usr/bin/env bash
# EXACT RC FIXTURES — generated by the auditor from a real checkout, never written by the compiler.
#
# FAIL-CLOSED (revision 8). Nothing is copied and no output directory is created until ALL FOUR
# preconditions hold:
#   G1  the source is a Git worktree
#   G2  HEAD equals the full expected RC SHA, exactly
#   G3  the worktree AND the index are clean
#   G4  each of the three files' working-tree bytes equal its HEAD blob
# A wrong HEAD, an unavailable identity, or a dirty source produces NO usable fixture set and a
# non-zero exit. There is no --force.
#
# READ-ONLY on the checkout. Writes only inside --out, and only after G1-G4 pass.
# No network. No provider access.
#
# Usage:
#   bash 13_make_rc_fixtures.sh --rc-root <checkout> [--out fixtures/rc-exact]
#   bash 09_rc_regression.sh --rc-root fixtures/rc-exact
set -uo pipefail; export LC_ALL=C
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
grep -q $'\r' "$0" 2>/dev/null && { echo "FATAL: CRLF line endings; re-checkout with LF."; exit 2; }

EXPECTED_RC=a42b209e4f70a6efed4f3dcdb654e0f994416594
FILES="
supabase/functions/submit-judge-decision/index.ts
supabase/functions/detect-orphan-files/index.ts
supabase/functions/_shared/transactional-email-templates/entry-winner.tsx
"

RCROOT=""; OUT="$HERE/fixtures/rc-exact"
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --rc-root) RCROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2;;
    --out)     OUT="${2:-}";    shift 2;;
    *) echo "FATAL: unknown argument: $1"; exit 2;;
  esac
done
[ -n "$RCROOT" ] || { echo "FATAL: --rc-root <checkout> is required."; exit 2; }
[ -d "$RCROOT" ] || { echo "FATAL: not a directory: $RCROOT"; exit 2; }
for t in sha256sum mkdir cp date; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FATAL: missing $t"; exit 2; }; done

echo "=== PRECONDITIONS (all four must pass before ANY file is copied) ==="
echo "source root : $RCROOT"
echo "expected RC : $EXPECTED_RC"
bad=0
say(){ printf '%-6s %s\n' "$1" "$2"; }

# ---- G1 · is this a Git worktree? -------------------------------------------
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  say FAIL "G1 git is not installed - source identity cannot be established"; bad=1
elif ! git -C "$RCROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  say FAIL "G1 not a Git worktree: $RCROOT"; bad=1
else
  say PASS "G1 source is a Git worktree"
fi

HEADC=""; HEADT=""
if [ "$bad" -eq 0 ]; then
  HEADC="$(git -C "$RCROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
  HEADT="$(git -C "$RCROOT" rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
fi

# ---- G2 · HEAD is EXACTLY the expected RC -----------------------------------
if [ "$bad" -ne 0 ]; then
  say SKIP "G2 not evaluated (G1 failed)"
elif [ -z "$HEADC" ]; then
  say FAIL "G2 HEAD could not be read - identity UNAVAILABLE"; bad=1
elif [ ${#HEADC} -ne 40 ]; then
  say FAIL "G2 HEAD is not a full 40-character SHA: $HEADC"; bad=1
elif [ "$HEADC" != "$EXPECTED_RC" ]; then
  say FAIL "G2 HEAD is $HEADC"
  say ""  "   expected $EXPECTED_RC - this checkout is NOT the frozen RC"; bad=1
else
  say PASS "G2 HEAD == $EXPECTED_RC"
fi

# ---- G3 · worktree and index are clean --------------------------------------
if [ "$bad" -ne 0 ] && [ -z "$HEADC" ]; then
  say SKIP "G3 not evaluated (no worktree)"
else
  dirty="$(git -C "$RCROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
  staged="$(git -C "$RCROOT" diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
  if [ "$dirty" = "?" ]; then say FAIL "G3 git status failed"; bad=1
  elif [ -n "$dirty" ] || [ -n "$staged" ]; then
    say FAIL "G3 source is DIRTY - tracked changes present:"
    printf '%s\n' "$dirty" | sed 's/^/         /' | head -10
    [ -n "$staged" ] && printf '%s\n' "$staged" | sed 's/^/         staged: /' | head -10
    bad=1
  else
    say PASS "G3 worktree and index are clean"
  fi
fi

# ---- G4 · every file's bytes equal its HEAD blob ----------------------------
if [ -z "$HEADC" ]; then
  say SKIP "G4 not evaluated (no worktree)"
else
  g4=0
  for rel in $FILES; do
    src="$RCROOT/$rel"
    if [ ! -f "$src" ]; then say FAIL "G4 missing in checkout: $rel"; g4=1; continue; fi
    wt="$(git -C "$RCROOT" hash-object -- "$rel" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
    hd="$(git -C "$RCROOT" rev-parse "HEAD:$rel" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
    if [ -z "$wt" ] || [ -z "$hd" ]; then
      say FAIL "G4 blob identity unavailable for $rel"; g4=1
    elif [ "$wt" != "$hd" ]; then
      say FAIL "G4 working-tree bytes differ from HEAD blob: $rel"
      say ""  "   worktree $wt  HEAD $hd"; g4=1
    fi
  done
  [ "$g4" -eq 0 ] && say PASS "G4 all three files match their HEAD blobs" || bad=1
fi

if [ "$bad" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "-----------------------------------------"
  echo "REFUSED: preconditions failed. NO fixture set was created and NOTHING was copied."
  echo "         $OUT was not written to."
  exit 1
fi

# ---- only now is anything written -------------------------------------------
mkdir -p "$OUT"
PROV="$OUT/FIXTURE_PROVENANCE.txt"
{
  echo "EXACT RC FIXTURES — provenance"
  echo "generated UTC : $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  echo "generator     : 13_make_rc_fixtures.sh (revision 8, fail-closed)"
  echo "source root   : $RCROOT"
  echo "git HEAD      : $HEADC"
  echo "git HEAD tree : $HEADT"
  echo "expected RC   : $EXPECTED_RC"
  echo "identity      : MATCH - this is the frozen RC"
  echo "worktree      : clean (tracked); index clean"
  echo "gates         : G1 worktree · G2 HEAD==RC · G3 clean · G4 bytes==HEAD blobs — ALL PASSED"
  echo ""
  echo "per-file record: <git blob sha1>  <sha256>  <bytes>  <path>"
} > "$PROV"

for rel in $FILES; do
  src="$RCROOT/$rel"
  mkdir -p "$OUT/$(dirname "$rel")"
  cp "$src" "$OUT/$rel"
  printf '%s  %s  %s  %s\n' \
    "$(git -C "$RCROOT" rev-parse "HEAD:$rel")" \
    "$(sha256sum "$src" | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
    "$(wc -c < "$src" | tr -d ' ')" "$rel" >> "$PROV"
done

{
  echo ""
  echo "These files are EXACT COPIES of $EXPECTED_RC, verified byte-for-byte against their HEAD"
  echo "blobs before copying. The elided-body caveat (B1) does NOT apply to this directory."
} >> "$PROV"

echo "-----------------------------------------"
cat "$PROV"
echo ""
echo "Next: bash 09_rc_regression.sh --rc-root \"$OUT\""
echo "A FAILURE there is a REAL FINDING: the recorded ground truth diverges from the real RC."
exit 0
